scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @remote-support/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @remote-support/api" "npm run dev --workspace @remote-support/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @remote-support/contracts && npm run build --workspace @remote-support/api && npm run build --workspace @remote-support/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @remote-support/contracts && npm run test --workspace @remote-support/contracts && npm run test --workspace @remote-support/api && npm run test --workspace @remote-support/web
